topic: Someone discovers their partner has been writing a novel about them
text: Finding out that my partner has been weaving our life into the threads of a novel, I can't help but walk through the day differently. Each page, it seems, holds a piece of us—moments fleeting yet captured, emotions raw and untamed. The world sharpens, colors deepen, as I imagine the words giving form to the shadows of our days. It's a strange sensation, knowing that our story, in all its complexity, is being told through someone else's eyes, yet it feels intimately right. The mundane becomes profound, and every glance, every word exchanged, resonates with a new depth.
